title: When the Static Wakes
author: Edmund Winterbourne
blurb: Ulyana Lockridge, a xenolinguist who can no longer dream in human languages, has spent seven years hauling cargo through contested orbits. Then the colony's children start sharing the same dream — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
